description: This section offers a brief overview of the progression guide and includes a table of contents to support navigation through the remaining sections.
content: OVERVIEW Hello! Welcome to the Slayer Legend guide created by me (Andy). While there are surely extreme min-max strategies out there, everything here comes from my own experience with characters on both Server 1 and Server 2. It applies to weapons, accessories, and even classes (five same-grade classes fuse to the next grade, which is exactly how you climb toward the top of the class ladder between lucky pulls). title: Core Mechanics
description: How Slayer Legend actually works - combat and stages, stats, mana and skills, the four elements, promotions, and idle rewards.
content: The Combat Loop Your Slayer walks right and kills what's in front of them. Each stage sends waves of monsters and ends with a boss challenge - beat the boss, advance to the next stage, repeat across 2,000 stages and 30+ regions (see the stage list). title: Progression Systems
description: How progression works in Slayer Legend - leveling, promotions, stage pushing, and the daily systems that compound into long-term power.
content: How Progression Works Slayer Legend's progression is a braid of three strands: your level (EXP), your stage (how far you've pushed), and your promotion rank (the permanent multipliers). They feed each other constantly - higher stages give more EXP and gold, more levels unlock systems and stat points, and promotions multiply you through the next set of stages. When one strand stalls, the other two are how you unstick it. That's the entire stra

title: Leveling Guide
description: Where EXP comes from in Slayer Legend, every level milestone that matters, and how to level efficiently from early game to late.
content: Why Levels Matter Your character level is quieter than promotions or equipment - no flashy multiplier attached - but it gates a surprising amount of the game. Levels grant growth points to allocate across your stats, promotions list recommended levels, and several whole systems simply will not open until you hit their level requirement. EXP is the slow current underneath everything else; you want it flowing at all times.

title: Resources & Farming
description: Every currency and material in Slayer Legend - what it does, where it comes from - plus the farming strategies that keep them all flowing.
content: Resources Overview Slayer Legend runs on an economy of a dozen-plus currencies, and each one is a bottleneck for something specific. Gold feeds stats, cubes feed equipment, stones feed companions, souls feed soul weapons - and your progression at any moment is usually limited by exactly one of them. Knowing which one, and where it comes from, is half of playing this game well. This section is the map.

content: Refinement Overview Refinement is the fine-tuning layer of the skill system: skill stones that attach to your equipped skills and bend their mechanics - shorter cooldowns, longer buff durations, faster trigger conditions. Where leveling a skill makes its numbers bigger, refinement changes its rhythm, and rhythm is what separates a skill bar that fires in clean rotation from one that sits idle waiting on cooldowns. Beat the boss and you advance; fail and you keep farming where you are, which is never wasted time - every reward the game gives scales with your stage number.
